name: pmc-write-the-recommendation
description: Writes the Recommendation as a Claude Doc with the call and the ask on the first line, three reasons tied to evidence, the options rejected and why, risks with mitigations and owners, and what is needed from whom by when. Use for "run pmc-write-the-recommendation", "write the recommendation from this analysis", "put the ask in the first line", "what are we rejecting, and why?", "make the call", "decision ask", "recommendation doc", part of the Claude Opus 5.5 for Product Managers Pack by 90n.
